newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Polledo loses $8.9 mln in 9 months. [CORRECTED 23:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Polledo loses $8.9 mln in 9 months. [CORRECTED 23:47 GMT]

text.p: Period to September 30. Net loss $8.9 million vs n/a.
NOTE: the company did not provide results for the third quarter nor EPS.
At September 30 net worth stood at $50.9 million. The firm reported negative retained earnings of $13 million. (Corrects by inserting dropped word negative).
Full company name is Polledo Sociedad Anonima, Industrial, Constructora y Financiera. - Guillermo Haskel, Buenos Aires Newsroom, 541 318-0650
